spans.s: This maxim lauds the spirit of endeavour. An ant for example, tries patiently and strenuously to climb the tree to taste a fruit. Similarly, the maxim states that a man can also accomplish difficult tasks by endeavouring patiently. Even to enjoy Brahma-realization patience of an ant is required.
The ants prepare an ant hill. But the serpents live in it The maxim is based on the situation in which one person strives to do something but somebody else enjoys the fruit of it.
